about: JR v10 layer plan (logs/ssl-claude-halloween/v10/brief.md): v9 unchanged (tools/v9_plan.json, the v9 configs, HUD / CG renders, ghost lines, sim, audio cues) except two photoreal Gemini plates approved by HAGINO. The Hachiko gate passage plate (gate route) and the opening Hachiko-mae reveal (rules, all pairs) use grounded-refs/v3/01-hachiko.png; every crush POV uses grounded-refs/v3/08-crush-pov.png. The costumed crowd is IN these photos, so on these shots the procedural costumed figures / press row / crush rows are not drawn. Read by tools/v10_composite.py and tools/v10_ghost.py.

hachiko3.what: Hachiko gate passage, Halloween night, costumed crowd (keep-left queue, stanchions)

crush3.what: eye-level crush POV in a packed costumed crowd at night (generic, no signage)

protect.about: plate-px boxes the ghost + bubble must never cover (faces of the photo people, the blank sign panel); checked per frame through the shot's camera by tools/v10_ghost.py

crush.about: crush POV camera on the photo: slow push-in (suffocating), sway, lurch + lateral kick on every shove (config crush.shoves = the shove SFX times), small roll, horizontal squeeze pulses, heartbeat vignette, desaturated shadows

aiTag.about: the crush POV is now a whole AI-generated photo, but its v9 HUD layer carries no plate tag: the compositor stamps the HUD's own 「AI生成画像を加工」 tag (pixels copied from a tagged v9 HUD frame, same place and look) on every crush-pov frame
